spaces.label: Salt Tower
spaces._note: Adjacent to Chapel Royal via secret passage.
Inner-ward hookpoint: (20,10) yellow, 2 spaces behind Constable between it and Broad Arrow.
Inner-ward hookpoint: (8,18) yellow, 2 spaces behind Flint between Bowyer and Flint.
Inner-ward hookpoint: (1,8) yellow, immediately past Beauchamp down the west wall.

spaces.label: Swap a card with another player
Chapel Royal of St Peter Ad Vincula
spaces._note: Connects to Salt Tower via secret passage.

spaces.label: Museum
spaces._note: Gives a tower card on landing (same mechanic as a tower).

spaces.label: Barracks
spaces._note: Warder storage only; not a playable player space. Rendered as a display strip.

spaces.label: Rack Sender
spaces._note: Landing here sends player to the Rack (iw_rack). Reusable built-in rope connects to iw_13_13 (see traversal_edges).
Exit of the White Tower path; also adjacent to Chapel of St John.

spaces.label: Chapel of St John
spaces._note: Reachable from wt_14_8 (exit of White Tower path) and from iw_16_4 via built-in ladder (not discarded). Note: iw_14_4 sits inside the White Tower envelope and is not a walkable iw cell — see open question about whether the chapel has a second ground-level entrance.

spaces.label: Cradle Tower (exit)
spaces._note: Escape point. Player banks a jewel, returns their coin, and redraws their hand (old cards reshuffled into the tower deck). In fast mode: game ends on first escape with 1+ jewel and coin. Slide (18,-2)-(18,1) between here and out_18_2.

traversal_edges.notes: Two-way, reusable. Entering the tower this way still obeys forward-only.
Two-way, reusable. Entering the chapel still obeys forward-only.
Bidirectional. Counts as one step of movement.

jewel_display_offset._note: Jewels are rendered one square to the right of their pink space.

rules._note_confine_on_landing: Walking onto the Bloody or Bowyer Tower is the same as being sent there: the door locks behind you. Beauchamp is the exception - see beauchamp_tower_confinement_only_from_raven_card.
